network_constraints: This network cannot reach these origin hosts: nrel.gov and atb.nrel.gov (no DNS answer), pnnl.gov, emp.lbl.gov, pjm.com, dataminer2.pjm.com, scc.virginia.gov, iea.org, ercot.com, dcc.ll.mit.edu (TLS handshake reset or HTTP 403). Files were taken from the publisher's own delivery host where one exists (AWS S3 / OEDI), otherwise from the Internet Archive. A public Cloudflare relay was tested and rejected because it silently corrupts binary payloads (UTF-8 replacement of high bytes); all files it produced were deleted.
